categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 『魔神英雄伝ワタル』より、創界山の守り神、金龍の魂が宿った魔神「龍神丸」がHGで登場！
description.en: From "Mashin Hero Wataru ", the demon " Ryujinmaru" inhabited by the soul of Kinryu, the guardian deity of Mt. Sokai, is now available in HG!

description.ja: • 原作イメージに忠実なプロポーションの本体各所に可動ギミックを凝縮。
description.en: • Movable gimmicks are condensed in various parts of the body with proportions that are faithful to the original image.

description.ja: • 内蔵された可動軸により、胸部両脇のブロックを前方へ引き出すことが可能。
description.en: • The built-in movable shaft allows the blocks on both sides of the chest to be pulled forward.

description.ja: • 肩部アーマー内に組み込まれた軸可動により、腕の可動域が拡大。
description.en: • Axial movement built into the shoulder armor expands the range of arm movement.

description.ja: • 引き出された胸部両脇のブロックはフレキシブルに可動し、肩部関節の引き出し機構と合わせて、必殺技「登龍剣」のポーズを実現。剣を抜く仕草も自然に再現できる。
description.en: • The pulled-out blocks on both sides of the chest can be moved flexibly, and together with the pull-out mechanism of the shoulder joints, the pose of the special move "Toryuken" is realized. The gesture of drawing a sword can also be reproduced naturally.

description.ja: • 腰部は引き出すことで股関節の可動域が拡大し、大胆なポージングが可能。
description.en: • By pulling out the waist, the range of motion of the hip joints is expanded, allowing for bold poses.

description.ja: • 膝アーマーは膝関節と連携して可動。
description.en: • Knee armor moves in conjunction with the knee joint.

description.ja: • シールレスで劇中のカラーリングを再現。肩アーマーの龍の模様もパーツ分割で表現。
description.en: • Reproduce the coloring in the movie without seals. The dragon pattern on the shoulder armor is also expressed by dividing it into parts.

description.ja: • 登龍剣に加え、ハンドパーツは握り手・武器持ち手・開き手の3種類が付属。
description.en: • In addition to the Toryu sword, three types of hand parts are included: a gripping hand, a weapon holding hand, and an open hand.
